paper.title: FLOWERS AEP: An Analytical Model for Wind Farm Layout Optimization

public_source.license_finding: no license file or license declaration found; semantic and numerical oracle only; no redistribution

paper_problem.wind_resource: public source WR7 WIND Toolkit rose reduced to average speed by one-degree direction
paper_problem.initial_layout: 3 by 3 array at x and y coordinates 3D, 7D and 11D
paper_problem.constraints: each turbine remains inside the square; no spacing constraint appears in Equation 45

paper_method.model: nondimensional closed-form FLOWERS AEP and analytical Cartesian gradient

missing_information: licensed SNOPT binary, version, options beyond the public wrapper and solver state
optimization history, final coordinates, summary file and complete numerical trajectory
exact pyOptSparse, NumPy, FLORIS and operating-system environment
random state and saved samples for the two unseeded 200-case experiments
postprocessed Conventional-Gauss AEP arrays used to evaluate all optimized layouts
paper_source_conflicts: Section 3 specifies an (N+1)-by-6 random-layout node array. Paper-era tools.py uses (N+1)-by-(N+1); current revision 749303c changes the second dimension to six. The paper and corrected source control the extension.
completion_decisions: Independently implement the printed FLOWERS AEP and analytical-gradient equations in C++20.
Recompute and retain only the ten WR7 Fourier coefficient facts required by the target problem; do not redistribute the unlicensed author source or pickle.
Replace unavailable SNOPT with deterministic projected limited-memory BFGS using the same analytical gradient, square bounds and 1e-3 projected-gradient tolerance.
Use the paper-corrected (N+1)-by-6 grid only for the separate deterministic N=500 H6 layout.
Treat the reported 13.8 percent objective gain as an external neighborhood check, not a fitted parameter.
Execute one paper-native deterministic optimization; do not invent repeated random seeds.

hpc_contract.model_stage: ordered O(N squared M) pair deficits and analytical derivatives
hpc_contract.parallel_axis: independent target-turbine rows followed by independent moved-turbine gradient slots
hpc_contract.synchronization: one barrier per pair stage and gradient stage with fixed index-order reductions
hpc_contract.determinism: same AEP, gradient, layout and scientific hash for one and all CPU workers
hpc_contract.h6_workload: WR7 N=500 M=10 AEP plus analytical gradient

formal_protocol.h6_worker_pair: one CPU worker versus every available Waffle CPU core

claim_boundary: Source-oracled flexible academic reproduction of the target FLOWERS model, analytical gradient and paper-native WFLO problem. It is not the author source distribution, SNOPT trajectory, FLORIS comparison baselines, randomized case corpus, postprocessed table identity or machine timing replay.
